# Whole-scene review synthetic checks

System-owned fixtures for native collision and material-copy checks. `check_native.py`
uses the small room generated by `../visualization/studio_lighting/build_scene.py`.
Run through `tests/integration/test_scene_review.py`; generated renders and logs live
under the selected test output directory and can be rebuilt. No case-specific assets.

`check_openings.py` verifies independent horizontal, vertical and diagonal opening assemblies, exact source extents, stable component grouping and glass transmission; run with `tests/integration/test_openings.py`.

`check_composition.py` verifies independent desk/chair complete framing, partition exclusion, mixed glass slots and interior window anchors without exterior eligibility. Run with Blender background `--python tests/fixtures/scene-review/check_composition.py -- <absolute src/interior/visualization>`; it creates only disposable synthetic in-memory geometry.

It also rejects an entirely obscured hero inside a visible companion group, so aggregate subject visibility cannot hide companion occlusion. Candidate metrics include relative-depth edge blockers and wide-angle ranking penalties.
